generate_flash_attention_kernels: generate flash attention CUDA kernel template instantiations for SM80, SM90 with configurable head dimensions and dtypes
run_generate_kernels_cli: run generate_kernels.py to write kernel .cu files to an output directory via argparse
build_kernel_dataclass: build a Kernel dataclass instance with sm, dtype, head_dim, direction and other flash attention configuration flags
get_all_kernels: get all flash attention kernel configurations by iterating dtype, head_dim, split, paged_kv, softcap, packgqa, and sm combinations
batch_kernels_by_hdim: batch kernel instantiations by head dimension grouping same-hdim and diff-hdim kernels into combined .cu files
